Chapter 7130: Worldbearer Firmament

Chapter 7130: Worldbearer Firmament

The power of the maelstrom grew continuously, absorbing essences from the twenty-four firmaments. If this continued, the whole world would be reduced to nothingness.

Suddenly, everyone heard a roar echoing through Divine Firmament. Radiant dimensions stacked upon each other and formed a colossal dragon. Enormous divine pillars also rose, bracing the belly of the great beast.

Powers of the world channeled through the pillars, increasing the dragon’s radiance and size.

“A true dragon?” Stone Immortal stood up again.

“Worldbearer Firmament, that’s its defense.” Chongming Immortal Monarch said.

“A cosmic ancestral dragon.” Li Qiye focused his gaze and saw a celestial girl standing on top of the coiling dragon.

“That’s a bloodline from the outside world, a mixed bloodline.” Stone Immortal became startled.

“Worldbearer Tortoise prepared for this long ago.” The monarch said while watching the pillars connecting with the great dragon: “This couldn’t be done overnight. Did Worldbearer Tortoise never leave?”

“Looks like you’re not alone, but this person is prepared to fight instead of waiting for death.” Li Qiye said.

“A worthy divine beast.” The monarch said.

The nine grand divine beasts didn’t necessarily refer to species but rather, the strongest and oldest divine beasts.

In the past, the list included Skykiller True Dragon, Phoenix Queen, Kun Peng, Qilin, Death Serpent, Worldbearer Tortoise, Gluttonous Beast, Lunar Wolf, and then Chongming Bird.

Chongming Immortal Monarch’s cultivation didn’t reach the right level to be included. However, his junior, Chongming Immortal Lord became the youngest divine beast with the most potential.

The strongest was none other than Skykiller True Dragon. However, he had died long ago along with Phoenix Queen. Thus, there were only seven left since no other true dragon or phoenix was able to reach the required level.

The oldest was Worldbearer Tortoise who was rumored to be dead, passing away peacefully at the bottom of an ocean in his firmament.

It turned out that he had been silently building a defense for his firmament - a testament to his will to rebel.

“I was only waiting for death...” The monarch became embarrassed and sighed.

He knew the truth but didn’t dare to face it, resorting to passivity and acceptance. On the other hand, one of the nine grand divine beasts wanted to protect his world.

“Boom!” Once Worldbearer Firmament and the cosmic ancestral dragon fused perfectly, they stopped the outflow of worldly essences.

“I’m sure Worldbearer Tortoise is there right now, it’s the reason why the grand momentum is so potent.” Stone Immortal said.

“Yes, he will defend his world to the death.” The monarch sensed a divine aura in the resistance.

This tortoise was more qualified than anyone to enjoy the resources within the new fortress to survive the calamity. However, he chose to fight to the bitter end.

“Buzz.” Inconspicuous red strings manifested into reality, traveling with unimaginable speed and wrapping around Skykiller Palace countless times.

A woman appeared; her presence alone locked space in place tightly. Her movement formed an immense tension.

She wore a red dress with silky ribbons everywhere, each stretching endlessly. As they unfurled, they could cover worlds and generate an infinite force pulling with her at the center.

The palace looked like a ball of red yarn, firmly under her grasp.
